notes.title: Unveiling Unique Mobile Suit Characteristics!
notes.content:
[h2][b]【Special Armor】[/b][/h2]
Some Mobile Suits are equipped with special armor that can nullify a certain amount of damage from ballistic attacks!

[h3][b]Phase Shift Armor / Variable Phase Shift Armor[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/4fa0049825280712eb6a6fa630e1bd0bcb7a6b29.jpg[/img]
The armor is designed to nullify a fixed amount damage from ballistic weapons. When damage exceeds a certain threshold, triggering Phase Shift Down, the armor changes to metallic gray and stops nullifying ballistic damage.

[h3][b]Trans-Phase Armor[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/130b8e3711dac1ff74676e90b8c38a6bd235d0e5.png[/img]
The armor is designed to nullify a fixed amount of damage from ballistic weapons. Despite undergoing Phase Shift Down, the armor color remains unchanged, and the energy depletion is visibly undetectable to the enemy.

[h2][b]【Swapping】[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/e9f7cce8cdfc6fcf00695f1f5466ca751abadf5a.jpg[/img]
Some mobile suits can transform into different forms even during combat by swapping packs! There is no limit to the number of times you can swap, allowing you to adapt to the battle, identify enemy's weaknesses, and conquer the battlefield!

[h2][b]【Transformation】[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/4f072f66785f5a5b613204b00fcd538a56f13bff.jpg[/img]
Transform from Mobile Suit form to Mobile Armor forms, such as fighter types and quadrupedal types! There is no limit to the number of transformations, so master both forms to outmaneuver your enemies!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1857740/SEED_BATTLE_DESTINY_REMASTERED/

notes.title: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Battle Destiny Remastered coming May 22nd 2025!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The remastered return of the fated battle.​
Fly into the battlefield, Gundam![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/c831416f13d48759bd2f8e160207bfc6c3c265bf.jpg[/img]

Become a pilot in the world of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, for the first time available with English localization! Engage in thrilling, action-packed Gundam battles, complete missions, and tune up your newly acquired Mobile Suits!

In the "Story Missions," relive legendary moments from Mobile Suit Gundam SEED and Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. Choose your faction from Earth Alliance Forces, ZAFT, or the Archangel, and complete missions alongside familiar pilots and Mobile Suits from the series.

Over 100 Mobile Suits are available to acquire and play from SEED, SEED Destiny and multiple spin-off titles!

-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ Destiny
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ C.E.73 -STARGAZER-​
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ ASTRAY​
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ X ASTRAY​
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ VS ASTRAY​
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ MSV​
-Mobile Suit Gundam SEED​ Destiny MSV​

All Mobile Suits have been redesigned with high-resolution model textures!

[h3]Watch the Announcement Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=NX1GfnTWz-w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]・Fully remastered with new graphics!
＜Original Version＞
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/ea674eeec4714b76760090db2251001caa87a419.jpg[/img]

＜REMASTERED version＞
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/649ccd81ed02b469b8a1925e7e65fbfa07d8c28b.jpg[/img]

・Easier to play and better than ever![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/6b1c776426863843c3d01162e511f75076bbb55e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/3989ce54b3be8194f75257ca6da4cee47ed981c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494704/5e3de9575db32759850a962a451cd0ff7332fb95.jpg[/img]

The UI has been fully redesigned for the current-generation systems, enhancing readibnility and ease of use across the board. Be it the battle scenes, tuning, or mission selection.
​
Additionally, new features such as a new lock-on mode have been added for a more comfortable and enjoyable experience.
